up: Find all compounds reported in document CHEMBL1142268. Return the following columns: ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), maximum clinical phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Order the results by ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1142268' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
